why.title: The Amazon needs technology designed from its own reality.
why.text: Many young people in Loreto, especially from peri-urban areas and riverside communities, have talent but few opportunities to train in technology. At the same time, Amazonian organizations and institutions need digital tools adapted to their context. Selva Stack brings both needs together.

cards.text: Limited access to training and digital tools far from the city.

cards.title: Talent without opportunity
cards.text: Capable young people with no space for real professional practice.

cards.title: Poorly adapted technology
cards.text: Solutions that ignore the Amazon's territory, culture and connectivity.

cards.title: Opportunity for change
cards.text: Technology strengthens education, civic participation and local development.

model.title: We don't just teach theory. Our youth build.
model.text: Every product we deliver is coded and designed by Amazonian youth, guided by mentors with professional experience. When a company hires us, it gets a quality solution and, at the same time, helps train a young person from the rainforest.

support.text: We're looking for founding partners, people and institutions from Peru and around the world, who want to empower Amazonian youth to build technology with purpose.

join.text: No prior experience needed, just the will to learn. We prioritize young people from peri-urban areas and riverside communities in Loreto. We also welcome professional volunteers.
